subject: Invoice delivery + remit coordination — preferred channel and onboarding steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Mills <laura.mills@greenriver.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery + remit coordination — preferred channel and onboarding steps

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To make the onboarding checklist concrete, quick question for AP: do you want Redwood invoices delivered as (pick one):

- emailed PDF to accounts-payable@greenriver.com (instant, keeps your mailbox workflow), or
- pushed via SFTP with nightly batches (structured, good for ERP ingestion), or
- API / portal pull (we post invoices and you fetch, supports JSON/XML payloads), or
- Peppol e-invoicing (if Green River is set up for Peppol receiving)?

Two follow-ups that will affect invoice creation and our tax tagging:
1) Do you need separate invoices per legal entity (you mentioned a multi-entity remit table), or a single consolidated invoice with entity-level line tagging?
2) For EU VAT handling (if any of your subsidiaries are EU-based), do you require an invoice PDF plus an accompanying structured XML with VAT breakdown?

If you prefer email, we can offer: PDF attachments + an optional machine-readable XML in the same message. If you prefer a push/API approach, we’ll add a test endpoint and sample payload.

I’ve attached a sample XML invoice layout and a short onboarding task list so your AP team can quickly confirm fields we’ll send. Can you please confirm preference and who will be our AP technical contact for the SFTP/API (if chosen)?

Goal: lock delivery method and remit mapping this week so finance can finish the billing setup and Ben can create the invoice profile in our system.

Thanks —

Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Partnerships
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(Attachment: sample_invoice_xml_v1.xml [XML], onboarding_task_list.pdf [PDF])

From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@greenriver.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenriver.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + remit coordination — preferred channel and onboarding steps

Hi Grace —

Thanks — good summary. Quick answers from AP:

- Preferred delivery: SFTP nightly push into our /invoices/inbound directory. We’ll accept PDFs plus a companion XML for ERPs.
- We need separate invoices per legal entity. We have three remit-to ledgers and each needs its own invoice number sequence.
- VAT: for the EU entity (Ireland), we require VAT line items in the XML and a separate PDF copy for the tax pack.

Technical contact for onboarding: me for requirements, but for SFTP keys and schema validation please loop in our IT integrator: Miguel Reyes <miguel.reyes@greenriver.com>. He can sign an SFTP key exchange and validate sample payloads.

One more ask: can Redwood support a weekly ‘invoice digest’ report that lists invoice numbers sent each night (CSV)? That helps our AP reconciliation.

Laura Mills
Director, Accounts Payable
Green River Logistics
(Attachment: none)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Mills <laura.mills@greenriver.com>, accounts-payable@greenriver.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + remit coordination — preferred channel and onboarding steps

Flagging next steps and constraints from Redwood ops:

1) SFTP nightly push: we can schedule a midnight UTC job to push a gzipped bundle containing PDFs + XML per entity. We need Green River to provide the SFTP host, path, and a public SSH key by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17).

2) Entity-level invoice numbering: our billing engine supports per-entity number sequences. We’ll need the remit-to ledger mapping CSV (fields: remit_entity_id, remit_name, currency, tax_id, invoice_prefix). Connor, can your team prepare the CSV template and share with Laura?

3) VAT handling: for the Irish entity we’ll populate VAT breakdown lines and include the tax-rate reference in the XML. We can also include a separate PDF tax pack if Miguel needs it.

4) Invoice digest: can be produced as a CSV and posted alongside the nightly bundle. Format example: invoice_number,entity_id,date,amount,currency,xml_path,pdf_path. Laura — confirm fields you want in the digest and whether you prefer CSV or JSON.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 06/16: Connor sends remit mapping template.
- Wed 06/17: Green River provides SFTP host/path + public key; Miguel validates sample.
- Thu 06/18: We run a test push with two sample invoices for validation.
- Fri 06/19: Go-live (nightly push).

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(Attachment: onboarding_task_list.pdf [PDF])

From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@greenriver.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + remit coordination — preferred channel and onboarding steps

On Mon, Jun 15, 2026 at 09:02 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Flagging next steps and constraints from Redwood ops:
>
> 1) SFTP nightly push: we can schedule a midnight UTC job to push a gzipped bundle containing PDFs + XML per entity. We need Green River to provide the SFTP host, path, and a public SSH key by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17).
>
> 2) Entity-level invoice numbering: our billing engine supports per-entity number sequences. We’ll need the remit-to ledger mapping CSV (fields: remit_entity_id, remit_name, currency, tax_id, invoice_prefix). Connor, can your team prepare the CSV template and share with Laura?

Thanks Ben — that timeline works for us. Miguel will generate the SSH key and I’ll send host/path by Wednesday.

For the digest, CSV is fine. Please include: invoice_number, remit_entity_id, date_issued (YYYY-MM-DD), net_amount, tax_amount, gross_amount, currency, file_name_pdf, file_name_xml.

One small compliance note: for our Irish entity, if a VAT-exempt line exists we need the exemption code included in the XML element <vatExemptionCode>. Can you confirm Redwood can add this field?

I’ll follow up with Miguel on the validation window.

Best,
Laura

(Attachment: sample_remit_mapping.csv coming separately from Miguel)
